guide:
Final Simulation 2: Manufacturing Business

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

ध्यान दें

दरें GST 2.0 (22-Sep-2025 से लागू) के अनुसार हैं। Practice में Question की दी हुई दर ही लगाएँ।

सबसे पहले — Manufacturing Simulation का क्रम

  • Company बनाएँ (Delhi, GSTIN 07AAECS8899P1Z4); F11 में GST, Inventory और BOM चालू करें। Opening Capital ₹10,00,000 (Bank)।
  • Masters: Raw Materials (Wood, Plywood, Fevicol, Polish, Screws) और Finished Good "Dining Set" बनाएँ; Dining Set में BOM।
  • BOM प्रति 1 Dining Set: Wood 8 Cu.ft; Plywood 1 Sheet; Fevicol 0.5 Kg; Polish 1 Ltr; Screws 2 Box।
  • Ledgers: Labour Charges, Factory Overheads (Additional Cost के लिए), Transport Charges (Indirect Expense)।
  • Raw Material Purchase → Transport Expense → Stock Journal (Manufacturing) → Labour Payment → Sales।
  • अंत में Stock Summary, GSTR-3B और P&L जाँचें; Backup लें।
outro:

1. Material + Labour + Overhead

3. Output − Input

problems.title: Shree Furniture Manufacturers — Raw Material से Sale तक (पूरा Chakra)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Firm: Shree Furniture, Delhi, GSTIN 07AAECS8899P1Z4। Capital ₹ 10,00,000 (Bank)। सभी खरीद-बिक्री पर GST 18%।

Finished Good: 'Dining Set' (1 Table + 4 Chairs)। BOM प्रति 1 Dining Set — Wood 8 Cu.ft; Plywood 1 Sheet; Fevicol 0.5 Kg; Polish 1 Ltr; Screws 2 Box। Labour ₹ 1,500 प्रति Set (Cost Centre/Ledger में); Factory Overheads = Material Cost का 10%।

  • 1st April — Purchased from Timber Hub, Delhi (Local, GSTIN 07AABCT6677Q1ZG): Wood 400 Cu.ft @ ₹1,000; Plywood 100 Sheet @ ₹1,200; Fevicol 50 Kg @ ₹250; Polish 40 Ltr @ ₹400; Screws 200 Box @ ₹50
  • 5th April — Transport Charges ₹ 5,000 (Bank से, GST नहीं मानें) — Raw Material की Cost में नहीं, Expense में
  • 10th April — 40 Dining Set का उत्पादन (Stock Journal — Manufacturing Journal, BOM के अनुसार); Labour Payment ₹ 60,000 (Bank)
  • 20th April — Sold 25 Dining Set @ ₹18,000 to Raj Interiors, Delhi (Local, GSTIN 07AAFCR2210R1Z7)
  • 25th April — Sold 8 Dining Set @ ₹19,000 to Urban Living, Karnataka (Inter-State, GSTIN 29AAFCU3321S1ZQ)

Required: Production Cost per Set, Closing Raw Material, Closing FG, Gross Profit, GST Liability पता कीजिए।
